function.description: Get the count of network devices affected or impacted by a specific network bug ID. Use this tool for questions like 'how many devices are impacted by CSCwd12345?' or 'count devices affected by bug CSCwr77118'. A CSC ID in a bug-impact count question is a network bug ID, not a security advisory ID. Do not use security advisory count tools for CSC network bug device-impact questions unless the user explicitly says security advisory, PSIRT, Cisco advisory, or CVE.
function.name: api_getCountOfNetworkBugDevicesForTheBug

id.description: Network bug ID, usually a CSC identifier such as CSCwd12345.

scanMode.description: Mode or the criteria using which the network device was scanned. Available values : ESSENTIALS, ADVANTAGE, CX_CLOUD, NOT_AVAILABLE

scanStatus.description: Status of the scan on the network device. Available values : NOT_SCANNED, IN_PROGRESS, SUCCESS, FAILED, FALL_BACK

count.description: Count of network devices affected by the specified network bug.
